hypothesis: What still breaks: a DBA with full access, JavaScript shipped by the server and a dishonest key holder still defeat Layer 2 (CONFIRMED = the attack works)
statement: All 7 limits held up in the lab: the key holder read 6 of 6 ballots with the voter code next to each; the hidden insert time re-linked 6 of 6; a DBA voted in the name of a registered voter with one UPDATE; a DBA dropped and rebuilt the tables without one ballot and the chain still verified; the owner made the tally refuse 2 honest ballots (this one is reported by the tally); a substituted vote.js read the choice; the verifier was replaced without a trace in the tables.

attacks.name: Read single ballots, with the voter name
attacks.detail: 6 of 6 ballots read, each next to its voter code

attacks.name: Re-link ballots to voters by the hidden insert time
attacks.who: Anyone who reads BLIND_BALLOTS and VOTER_ROLL
attacks.detail: 6 of 6 paired by ORABCTAB_CREATION_TIME$ against VOTER_ROLL.voted_at, without reading BALLOT_SEALS

attacks.name: Vote in the name of a registered voter who has not voted
attacks.who: A DBA who can write to VOTER_ROLL
attacks.detail: one UPDATE of VOTER_ROLL.public_key, then the ordinary API: ballot 7 accepted and counted; the voter, coming back, is told the code has been used

attacks.name: Remove a ballot by dropping and rebuilding the tables
attacks.detail: the chain verified over the rebuilt tables; 5 ballots counted while VOTER_ROLL says 6 voted, and nothing compares the two

attacks.name: Make the tally refuse honest ballots, after disabling the primary key and dropping the foreign key
attacks.detail: 2 honest ballots not counted; the tally lists them as rejected, with the reason

attacks.name: Read the choice in the browser, with JavaScript shipped by the server
attacks.who: Whoever can change the static files of the application
attacks.detail: a substituted vote.js ran in the voter tab and read the choice before it was encrypted; the ballot was accepted as usual

attacks.name: Replace the verifier
attacks.who: The owner of the schema (or a DBA)
attacks.detail: the class that checks every proof and signature was replaced; the ballot tables, their chain and the tally answer show nothing
